svg.text: claudia — styles round: Format menu with “Apply style ▸”
Proposal for review — nothing is built. Same four entries in composes, computes and creates; the styled entries are drawn the way the style looks.
Four entries. The style list moves into the flyout; each name is drawn in its own type and colour.
Apply style ▸ holds the list that used to sit at the top of Format. Edit this style…, All styles… and Colours… stay as
Each entry uses its style’s font, weight, italics and colour (the same “preview” the style gallery already draws) —
but not its size, so the menu keeps one rhythm.
A style with a background keeps it as a small chip behind the name, so you judge the colour against its real ground,
in light and dark mode alike.
✓ marks the style of the paragraph the caret is in; choosing an entry applies it and returns focus to the text.
“to name” pill as in the gallery. Groups as D127 (structure · running text · called-out blocks), then your own styles;
a long list scrolls inside the flyout.

drawn in its style’s font, weight, italics, colour and background
chip, with CSS — the preview the style gallery already draws.
